name: Cancellation by Host
beschreibung: The host cancelled your booking at the last minute and you are left without accommodation? We help you claim a full refund and, if applicable, compensation for the additional costs of a replacement hotel.

name: Mould, Dirt & Pests
beschreibung: Mould in the bathroom, cockroaches in the kitchen, or just dirty bed linen? You do not have to accept such hygiene issues. Document everything for your AirCover refund.

name: False Information & Fake Photos
beschreibung: The luxury villa turns out to be a basement flat, or the photos in the listing were completely outdated? If the property does not match the description, you are entitled to a significant price reduction.

name: Missing Amenities (Wi-Fi, Pool, AC)
beschreibung: No Wi-Fi despite planning to work from home, or the advertised pool is green and unusable? Missing guaranteed amenities entitle you to a reduction in the rental price.

name: Unlawfully Withheld Deposit
beschreibung: The host claims damages after departure that you did not cause and keeps the deposit? Defend yourself against unjustified claims and demand your money back.

name: AirCover Claim Rejected
beschreibung: Airbnb closed your case or rejected the refund even though the issue was obvious? Increase the pressure with an official legal letter to their legal department.

name: General Airbnb Issue
beschreibung: Is your specific issue not listed above? No problem. Use this general form to legally file a complaint for any kind of defect or issue with Airbnb.
